summary: This standards-track document defines SIP response code 199, Early Dialog Terminated. A forking proxy or user agent server can send it to say that an early dialog has ended before the final response. Callers can then clean up state for that attempt.

eli5.summary: When a call rings several phones at once, some stop ringing early. Code 199 tells the caller that one of those ringing attempts is over.

questions: how to signal end of early dialog in sip
